definitions.alternative_correspondence_positions: query positions having more than one distinct reported correspondence
definitions.coverage: corresponding union positions / entire operand length; zero denominator gives null
definitions.distinct_correspondence_count: number of distinct (query position, exact reference identity, reference position, strand) tuples
definitions.exact_duplicate_row_count: sum(group size - 1) for exact retained PAF rows excluding row locators
definitions.missing: repetition scalars null if any supplied row lacks usable geometry; observed subset remains separately labeled
definitions.population: supplied placements for this exact query; output completeness is separately declared
definitions.repeated_correspondence_positions: query positions having the same exact correspondence reported more than once
definitions.reported_placement_count: count(valid supplied rows matching exact query name and length)
definitions.union_positions: size of zero-based half-open interval union; repeated bases counted once
